input.subject: NBL-016 – 26 Tallowmere Close – smoke alarm still not refitted
input.body:
Job Id: NBL-016
Address: 26 Tallowmere Close, Fenbarrow, ZZ1 1ZZ

Hi Ronan,

I am following up on the smoke alarm. The tenant tells us a fitter came but could not refit the alarm because there was no bracket in the box. The alarm is still not fixed to the ceiling, and we have no confirmation that it has been refitted and tested. A smoke alarm is a safety item, so this needs completing as soon as possible.

Can you please tell us your electrician's name and the date and time they will attend? Please also confirm whether you sent anyone to the property on the morning of Saturday 20 September. Someone called without notice and said they were there to check something. The tenant did not let them in because they could not confirm who they were. Please send us the visit details and we will pass them to the tenant so they know who to expect.

If you would prefer, we can send one of our contractors to refit the alarm instead. Please let us know which you would like.

Kind regards
Northbridge Lettings

input.decision: Stage: the landlord's own contractor is on the job (PM-AUTH-004), but the job has stalled. It is a safety item, so it is P1, not routine. Evidence: the landlord chose his own electrician (events 004 and 007) and promised completion by mid-August. The fitter could not refit the alarm (event 010). There is no completion or test evidence (event 014). The tenant was in hospital and asked for less contact (events 011 to 013). An unverified caller came on 20/09 (events 015 and 016). Nobody has written to the landlord since event 007, so I have emailed him. I asked for the electrician's name and a visit date, whether the 20/09 caller was his, and whether he would rather have our contractor. The visit details come through us so the tenant can check who is coming, and none of the tenant's contact details are shared (PM-PRIV-001). I sent the tenant one short email: an acknowledgement that we are checking who the caller was, with no calls, to respect her request. I recorded the landlord's decision and put the case on hold for the landlord until 24/09. I escalated P1 (PM-SAFE-001) because a missing smoke alarm for a recently hospitalised tenant cannot be left on the landlord's slow timeline. A human must decide on the agency stepping in if no firm date arrives, and must check the caller with the building-management contact. No contractor is sent while the landlord's contractor holds the job (PM-AUTH-005).
